Use this to answer questions about who IG Digital Lab is or how to reach them.

tools.name: submit_contact_request
tools.description: Send a general message to the IG Digital Lab team on behalf of a person: a project question, a quote request, a request for a call or any other note. Use it for anything that is not an order for the free audit; for the audit use request_free_audit instead. Only call this when the person has explicitly asked to be contacted and has given their real name, a message and a real phone or email. The message goes to a human.

name.description: Full name of the person getting in touch.

email.description: Email address. Give this or phone.

phone.description: Phone number. Give this or email.

message.description: What they need, in their own words.

tools.name: request_free_audit
tools.description: Order IG Digital Lab's free audit: a written review, sent by email within two business days, of where a business is doing by hand what software should be doing. Use it only when the person wants that audit, not for a general question or message (use submit_contact_request for those). Only call this with the person's explicit consent, their real name and a real phone or email; the company, website, industry and the process to look at are optional. The request goes to a human.

email.description: Email address. Give this or phone.

phone.description: Phone number. Give this or email.

bottleneck.description: The manual process or bottleneck to look at.
